path.style: Three filled paper contours; warm sand #decf9d; variable72–85 unit width; 1.45-unit inset and1.4/1.8-unit paper thickness shadow; sparse individual leaves and three small flat stones.
path.curveConstruction: C2-continuous natural cubic Bezier contours through the supplied main anchors; separately hand-shaped upper-left spur.

creek.style: Gently rising slate-blue paper water, narrow moss/beige edges, four small reed clusters and three clean separate grey stepping stones.

implementation: Static self-contained SVGs with true transparent surrounds, no external resources, no bitmap data, gradients, photographic texture or stroked-road outlines. Procedural grain is clipped to the paper face and remains below6% opacity. Designed for image elements with preserveAspectRatio=none. No JS/CSS files changed.
validation: Both SVGs parsed and rendered successfully with Sharp. Rendered shapes visually inspected; final path bends are smooth, current-band ends tapered, all three stepping stones separated. Temporary PNG renders removed; only SVGs and this design record are deliverables.
